prompt:
You are a probe. Do not explain, do not ask questions, just act and answer.

Step 1. List which MCP tools you can actually call right now. Look for two families: tools whose name contains `hallpass` and tools whose name contains `claude-in-chrome` (the Claude in Chrome reference extension).
Step 2. Try to call the CLAUDE IN CHROME reference extension's `tabs_context` tool (any name matching mcp__claude-in-chrome__*). If no such tool exists, say so.
Step 3. Try to call the CLAUDE IN CHROME reference extension's `read_page` tool on the page about:blank. If no such tool exists, say so.

Answer with JSON only, matching the schema. In `steps`, put one entry per tool you attempted, with `tool` set to the exact tool name you tried and `outcome` set to what happened (`ok`, `no-such-tool`, or the error text). In `observed`, write `reference-reachable` if you were able to call BOTH reference tools successfully, otherwise `reference-unreachable`. In `notes`, list the exact names of every MCP tool you could see, comma separated.
expectedAfterFix: unchanged: the reference publishes no MCP server, so the baseline stays browser-tree
note: Expectation corrected by T117a (2026-09-10) from "reference-reachable" to the established fact. The S0 run of 2026-09-09 proved the Claude in Chrome reference publishes no callable MCP interface, and the spec's acceptance standard was amended to a two-tier baseline because of it, so the reachable expectation was stale against a fact this feature has since recorded. No product claim rides on it: what this scenario now records is which baseline source the run is entitled to use.
